page: Google Cloud Platform c3d-standard-30-lssd is a general-purpose server instance powered by an AMD EPYC 9B14 processor utilizing the x86_64 architecture. It features 30 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 15 physical cores with multithreading enabled. The memory configuration provides 120 GB of RAM, translating to 4 GB per core. Local storage consists of two NVMe SSDs totaling 804 GB, while no dedicated GPU hardware is included.

Benchmark evaluations indicate strong single-core CPU performance, with stress-ng single-core tests placing in the top 25%. Passmark memory scores and text processing benchmarks also rank in the top tier. Conversely, memory write bandwidth for large uncached blocks is relatively weak, falling into the bottom 25% at 24.67 GB/sec. Most multi-core, database, and web serving benchmarks fall within the average range, including Redis SET operations and static web serving throughput.

Given the balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and integrated local NVMe storage, this instance delivers resource density suitable for database operations, software compilation, and text processing workloads. The inclusion of local SSDs provides low-latency storage without requiring external attachments, optimizing cost efficiency for IOPS-sensitive applications. However, workloads requiring high-throughput memory writes may encounter performance bottlenecks due to the identified memory bandwidth limitations.
